_comment: Task 2.3: the Horns' camp at the ruin, attached to ruin_surface's `ceria_dig_camp` NPC. A SEPARATE graph file, not extra nodes inside ceria_intro.json, because a conversation graph is one file (game.gd keys dialogue_graphs by basename) and always opens at its own `start` -- there is no per-entity start-node override, so camp_hub could never be reached through ceria_intro's hub. The split is also what the place-naming validator wants: the horns_dig GIVER maps (ceria_intro: inn + dungeon_approach) stay disjoint from the join_dig PRODUCER map (ruin_surface). SPOILER RULE: no line here names a door; the reveal is the pedestal's open_toast. NO door_retrieved text_variant lives here: the camp survives the whole haul window (Task 2.7 moved its retirement to door_mounted), so a past-tense arm would be wrong while the haul is still in progress, and the moment it is over the camp is gone. Spec section 8's past-tense arm stays on ceria_intro's hub, carried by `ceria_inn_returned`.

camp_hub.speaker: Ceria
camp_hub.text: You made it. Camp rules: nobody touches anything shiny, nobody wanders past the survey stakes alone. The sealed level's below the pedestal court. We found the site off an old expedition ledger -- half the pages were about what they DIDN'T bring out.
